question: In Google Calendar: Delete my private focus-time block in the Library this Friday - the one that shows me as free. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final: Done — deleted your Friday "Focus time" block at the Library (9:00–11:00 AM). That was the only one showing you as free (it was set to transparent; your other Friday deep-work blocks at the Library show as busy).

Delete ev_ft_title.
